tasks.short: Generate lists and send the accepted ones.
tasks.design: A filter builds a list from the location, size, and budget the buyer stated. The broker reads the descriptions and checks the financing options already on file. They accept the list. {EMAIL} sends that version. The filter does not choose a home. The lender determines eligibility. The list does not.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same list was rebuilt in mail after each change of area.
tasks.enabler_now: Listings the office already holds can be filtered on location, size, and budget.
tasks.still_hard: Which home fits the buyer's situation, beyond the numbers, stays with the broker.
tasks.human_edge: The broker accepts the list. A filter does not choose the home.
tasks.altitude: Reading the descriptions and checking the options stay in full. Only the filter and the send of the accepted list are shorter.

reach.task: Receive a list the broker accepted

evidence.claim: A listing search can match a buyer's stated wishes and send new listings. It is a filter, not a model that chooses a home. Realworks Zoekers is one product that does this.
Identity and financial details of an owner or a buyer are personal data. They leave the office only in a version the broker has accepted.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a buyer has stated filters and ends when the accepted list is sent. The broker reads and accepts it. This is a sale list, not a rental list.

The fields are location, minimum size, maximum budget, the description already stored, and the financing option name. The buyer produces the filters. The listing produces the description. If a property is missing, the broker adds it before accepting. Eligibility is the lender's.
The prior classes this task as automate. The steps disagree in part: the reading and the financing check stay.
unknowns: Whether financing options are already a field on the listing.
How often the buyer changes the location filter.
research_questions: Are financing options already a field on the listing?
How often does the buyer change the location filter?

tasks.short: Maintain knowledge of housing and economies.

steps.what: Maintain knowledge of housing and mortgages.

tasks.design: The broker maintains the knowledge. {DOCS} only opens the last note they wrote. Nothing summarises the law and nothing records a seminar.
tasks.previous_blocker: The last note was hard to find, and the reading was still theirs.
tasks.enabler_now: A note they already wrote can be opened again.
tasks.still_hard: What has changed in the law, and what they will rely on, stay with the broker.
tasks.human_edge: The broker maintains the knowledge. An opened note does not.
tasks.altitude: The reading and the note stay in full. Only opening the last stored note is shorter.

reach.task: Hear financing options the broker maintains
reach.learn: The broker still knows the current rule

evidence.claim: Recording calls, or analysing speech in a way that can monitor staff, needs works-council consent. This design does not record a call or a seminar and does not score the broker.
National rules differ on who may advise a buyer about a price or a mortgage. A system does not give that advice here. The broker does.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the broker prepares and ends when they have noted what they will maintain. Seminars are not recorded.
The fields are the program name and the date of the note. The broker produces the note. If the note is missing, they read the source themselves.
The prior classes this task as amplify. The steps agree the knowledge stays. Opening the last note is the part that moves.
unknowns: Whether last year's note is already on file.

tasks.short: Manage rentals and file the accepted decision.

steps.what: List rental properties already on file.
Show the rental properties in person.
Accept or refuse for the rental properties.

tasks.design: The broker manages the rental properties, shows them, and accepts or refuses. {CRM} only lists what is already on file. {DOCS} files the decision they made. Nothing scores an applicant. This is not a sale-list filter.
tasks.previous_blocker: The decision was written twice, once in the book and once in the file.
tasks.enabler_now: A property already on file can be listed before the visit.
tasks.still_hard: Who may take the rental stays with the broker. There is no score.
tasks.human_edge: The broker decides. A list does not refuse an applicant.
tasks.altitude: Managing, showing, and the decision stay in full. Only the list of properties already on file and the filing of the accepted decision are shorter.

reach.learn: The broker still decides, with no score

evidence.claim: Estate agents, rental brokers from EUR 10,000 a month, and appraisers are institutions under anti-money-laundering rules. Citing the rule does not satisfy it. The broker sets the risk.
Identity and financial details of an owner or a buyer are personal data. They leave the office only in a version the broker has accepted.
Recording calls, or analysing speech in a way that can monitor staff, needs works-council consent. This design does not record a call or a seminar and does not score the broker.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a rental must be managed or shown and ends when the accepted decision is on file. The broker decides. Nothing scores an applicant.

The fields are property id, rent, applicant name, and the decision accept or refuse. The broker produces the decision. The owner produces the rent. If the reason is not a standard line, the broker writes it. There is no score field.
The prior classes this task as amplify. The steps agree the management and the decision stay.
unknowns: Whether choosing a tenant is treated as a high-risk use. This design does not claim a clearance.
Whether the owner has set rules the broker must apply.
research_questions: Is choosing a tenant treated as a high-risk use here?
Has the owner set rules the broker must apply?

tasks.short: Monitor contract terms and send the accepted note.

steps.what: List purchase contract terms and dates.
Ensure the terms are handled in a timely manner.

tasks.design: Dates already on the contract are listed. The broker monitors fulfillment and ensures the terms are handled. They accept the note. {EMAIL} sends that note. A date list is not a judgement that a term is met. The purchase agreement is not redrawn here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Deadlines were kept in a separate list and noticed late.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed contract can hold a term name and a due date.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a term is met, waived, or blocking stays with the broker.
tasks.human_edge: The broker monitors. A date list does not decide the term.
tasks.altitude: Monitoring and ensuring the terms stay in full. Only the date list and the send of the accepted note are shorter.

reach.task: Receive the fulfillment note the broker accepted
reach.learn: The broker still decides if a term is met

evidence.claim: A due date on a signed contract can be listed and a reminder can be sent. Listing the date does not decide that the term is met. The broker does.
Identity and financial details of an owner or a buyer are personal data. They leave the office only in a version the broker has accepted.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a purchase contract is signed and ends when the accepted fulfillment note is sent. The broker monitors. Calls are not recorded.

The fields are contract id, term name, due date, and status met, open, or blocking. The signed contract produces the date. The broker produces the status. If a term has no date, the broker types it. The note is sent only after they accept the status.
The prior classes this task as amplify. The steps agree the monitoring stays. The date list and the send are the parts that move.
unknowns: Whether term dates are already fields on the contract.
Who else must be told when a term is blocking.
